text:
deploy-bot: Canary checks triggered at 12:04 UTC — p95 latency +40% vs baseline for model-2b; error-rate 6.2% (threshold 5%). Recommendation: AUTO-ROLLBACK for canary slice (10%) due to kernel regression in kv-cache handling.
Maya: Copy. What exactly will the rollback do — full service revert or targeted runtime/kernel rollback?
Evan: It's the kernel optimization flag change we rolled in. Prefer targeted rollback of runtime image (kernel patch) not a full app revert. Command we used in staging: `kubectl set image deployment/inference runtime=image:v3.3.9`
Cara: Heads up — Dedicated customers may see the canary revert. We should prepare a brief customer-safe note if we go auto. No config/data changes, just runtime image.
Ben: I'm +1 for auto on the canary slice only so we get signal. Manual gating for production. I'll take oncall and watch metrics — putting hold/monitor at 12:05 UTC. :eyes:
Maya: Agree with Ben — auto for canary, manual for full rollout. Also recommend pinning Dedicated pools until we have a hotfix.
deploy-bot: AUTO-ROLLBACK initiated on canary slice at 12:06 UTC — rolling runtime -> image:v3.3.9. Rollback ETA ~90s.
Evan: Pinned dedicated pools to v3.3.9 via infra API: `POST /infra/pools/pin {"pool":"dedicated-eu","version":"v3.3.9"}` — verified.
Cara: Drafting customer note: "We’ve temporarily reverted a recent runtime kernel change after observing higher latency in canary. No data or config changes; we expect stabilized performance while we ship a fix." Will drop in #customer-comms for review.
Alex: Freezing release notes: adding bullet "temporary rollback of kernel patch affecting kv-cache; investigating performance regression". Hold any new releases until INF-4312 resolved.
Ben: Deploy-bot reports: rollback completed for canary slice (10%). Quick metrics: p95 now +2% vs baseline, error rate 0.9%. No rollback on prod pools. :thumbsup:
deply-bot: (system) Rollback success confirmed at 12:08:12 UTC; canary slice healthy.
Maya: Follow-ups: open ticket INF-4312, assign to runtime, add QA test for kv-cache regression, schedule hotfix. Also decide SLA comm path if Dedicated impact >0.5% of active customers.
Evan: INF-4312 created and linked PR #789. ETA for kernel patch/hotfix ~3 hours.
Cara: Once Ben confirms 15m stable window I'll send the customer-safe note. If anything degrades we'll escalate to enterprise CSMs and prepare one-pager for affected Dedicated customers.
Ben: Monitoring. Will post another update at +15m or earlier if noise.
Maya: Thanks team — good decision to keep the auto for canary and manual for prod. Let's reconvene in 30m if PR progress stalls.
